notes.title: Patch A1.1.1: 'Miss' Balancing
notes.content:
After playtesting and receiving numerous feedback, we've come to understand the detrimental impact of excessive 'miss' occurrences during attacks. Consequently, we've made significant adjustments to the accuracy of attacks for both players and monsters.

[b]Player Attacks:[/b]

All player attacks now have a base accuracy of 100%. Furthermore, this accuracy increases when advancing to higher-tier classes.

[b]Enemy Attacks:[/b]

Enemy attacks have been recalibrated for improved accuracy. At level 1, monsters now possess a hit-rate of 75%, which scales up with their level.

[b]Affected Accuracy:[/b]

Despite these changes, players may still experience reduced accuracy due to certain states or when equipping specific weapons or armors.

[b]Increased Evasion:[/b]

Additionally, enemy evasion rates have been enhanced based on their stats.

[b]Announcement:[/b]

Typically, we update patches on Wednesdays. However, due to a busy schedule this month, our update schedule may vary. Rest assured, normal patching frequency will resume next month. In the meantime, we've implemented this balancing patch. We encourage you to share your feedback on the Steam community forum, as we value and consider input from all players.

notes.title: A1.1.0 - Partner Patch
notes.content:
[u][b]Partners and Summoners:[/b][/u]

- Updated all partners acquired when changing class to the partner user class.
- Added class and skill trees for three types of partners.
- Introduced the Partner Item Shop in Nenir Kingdom.
- Established a new location for acquiring both partner user and summon user classes.
- Players now have two options for obtaining these classes:
            The original location, which is slightly challenging to access.
            A new, easier-to-reach location. However, players only have one chance to change their class at this location. If they decline, they can no longer change their class there.

[b](Small) Quality of Life Improvements:[/b]

- Temporarily added icons for purchasing skills on the skill tree and certain items.
- These icons include Mastery Crystal, EXP Incense, Raw Meat, Carrot, and Herb.
- Updated the 'Combat Guide' with clearer instructions to inform players about the 'normal attack seal' effect after equipping (most) weapons.

[b]Announcements:[/b]

- This patch marks the final update for 'Seed of the World: Seeding' (demo).
- Non-critical bugs will no longer receive updates for demo.

notes.title: A1.0.2 - Balancing Patch / Quality of life improve
notes.content:
[b]Map Change:[/b]

Quetta Village Head's Room:
No longer supports dashing.

Quality of Life Improvements:
Farmer Quest in Quetta Village:
After completion, players can sell '??? Seed' to the farmer at a rate of 1 piece for 5 gold.

[b]Balancing Adjustments:[/b]

Wealth Blessing:
Gold value increased from 50 to 500.

Nerf:
Bane 1✰: Bane Split:
Damage reduced.
Repeat decreased from 3 to 2.
Slight increase in the chance to inflict the poison state.

Buffs:
All "Guard" Skills:
Restore some MP, the amount varying based on the Max MP and type of the Guard skill.

notes.title: A1.0.1 - Balancing Patch
notes.content:
[u][b]Monster Changes:[/b][/u]

- Increased the effectiveness of curses on all monsters during the first 3 days for a smoother start.
- Removed monster blessings after players change their class from "no class."
- Activated monster blessings when a player reaches level 10, with more potent effects at level 20 (only affects monsters below level 5).

[u][b]Skill Weapon and Armor Adjustments:[/b][/u]

- Nerfed the skill "Wind 1✰: Wind push" for situations where enemies can one-shot players:
                   Damage: Massively reduced
                   Status Effect: Slightly increased chance
- Nerfed the weapon 'Stick':
                   Stats:   Attack: 6 > 5
                               Defense: 0 > -1
                               Magic Defense: 0 > -1
- Buffed the weapon 'Broken Staff':
                   Stats: Magic Damage 5 > 7
- Buffed armor 'Torn Cloth':
                   Stats: Max HP 7 > 10
- Buffed armor 'Old Shoes':
                   Stats: Agility 3 > 5

[u][b]Experience Gain:[/b][/u]

Increased experience gain:
No Class: +20%
Class Tier 1: +10%

[u][b]Map Changes:[/b][/u]

Slightly reduced the chance for encounter for all maps.

[u][b]Campfire Changes:[/b][/u]

- Changed the design of the campfire.
- Campfires can now save and rest even after burning out, but there is an increased chance of being ambushed by monsters.
- Added the text 'Time Passes' to the choices 'Rest' and 'Meditation' at a normal campfire to inform players that they can rest on the next day.
- Added the text 'Harmful' to the choice 'Rest' at burned-out campfires to warn players about the increased chance of being ambushed by monsters.
- Added more campfires around the continent.

[u][b]Item Adjustments:[/b][/u]

- Increased the number of Dilute Potions obtainable at the start from 3 to 5.
